# Rounded Reveal

**Wipe › Shape Mask** · v1.0.0 · 30 frames at 30 fps (14–60)

The new scene opens in a rounded window that grows from the centre to full frame, settling from a slight zoom inside.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/rounded-reveal@1.0.0.mp4)

## Where it is used

- App and product demos
- Clean corporate edits
- Revealing a screen recording

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import roundedReveal from './transitions/03-wipe/shape-mask/rounded-reveal';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(roundedReveal, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 30 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Range | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | number | `0.5` | 0–1 | Window centre x. |
| `y` | number | `0.5` | 0–1 | Window centre y. |
| `corner` | number | `0.08` | 0–0.3 | Corner radius as a share of frame height (it eases to square at the end). |
